meta.title: UNDP Chad — Annual Report 2025
meta.description: Where UNDP made a difference in 2025: results from Chad in governance, climate, stabilization, health and youth.

hero.title: Where UNDP made a difference in 2025
hero.intro: In 2025, Chad continued to strengthen its institutions and advance its development priorities, marking a new chapter for the country. Throughout the year, we worked with the Government, communities and development partners to strengthen institutions and improve the lives of the country's most vulnerable people.

impact.context: Between 2024 and 2025, Chad continued to face persistent economic, social, climate and institutional challenges, against a backdrop of rapid population growth and significant demand for basic services. At the same time, the country holds considerable potential, driven by a predominantly young population and opportunities for structural transformation still to be realized.
impact.lead: Chad's future is shaped by both immense potential and significant challenges.

stats.label: children are learning in safer schools
households are better protected, benefiting nearly 10,000 people

impact.transition: Working alongside the Government, local authorities, communities and development partners, we delivered results that are improving people's lives across Chad.

chapters.title: Building trust in institutions
chapters.intro: We supported more transparent, inclusive and accountable institutions through digital transformation, decentralization and greater participation in public life.

blocks.heading: Strengthening transparency and public accountability
blocks.body: A new national digital platform supports more effective monitoring of government performance, enabling better-informed decision-making. Legal and regulatory texts dating back to 1954 are now publicly accessible through the Official Gazette digital platform.

blocks.heading: Local governments growing into drivers of development
blocks.body: A National Seminar on Decentralization, chaired by the President of the Republic, brought together more than 300 stakeholders. 10-year National Decentralization Roadmap adopted and disseminated nationwide. A shared national framework is now helping place local governments at the heart of development.

items.label: Women's representation increased in national and local elected bodies
Persons with disabilities regained mobility and independence through assistive devices
detainees received legal aid through mobile court hearings

chapters.title: helping communities withstand crises
chapters.intro: Across the Lake Chad Basin and eastern Chad, we helped communities strengthen resilience by improving security, restoring essential services and preventing conflict.

blocks.heading: Restoring hope around Lake Chad Basin
Supporting refugees and host communities
blocks.body: 3,000 people now have access to safe drinking water in Iriba. Communities in Adré have improved access to education and essential community services through new public facilities. More than 1,000 women strengthened their livelihoods through targeted income-generating support.
highlights: access to education and essential community services

chapters.title: advancing climate resilience and clean energy
chapters.intro: From flood protection to renewable energy, we helped communities adapt to climate change while creating new opportunities for livelihoods.

chapters.title: expanding access to quality health services
chapters.intro: We supported stronger health systems by improving disease prevention, modernizing health facilities and accelerating digital innovation.

blocks.heading: Health facilities better equipped to deliver care
blocks.body: 100 health centres and 11 hospitals equipped with medical equipment and cold chain systems. Solar energy helps ensure continuity of essential health services.
highlights: Solar energy helps ensure continuity of essential health services

blocks.heading: Smarter medicine supply systems
blocks.body: Pharmaceutical supply chain fully digitalized. Digital tools improved stock management and medicine distribution.

chapters.intro: We worked with young people to strengthen their digital skills, shape public dialogue and contribute to the future of the Sahel.

priorities.title: Building on these results, we are ready to scale up impact.

items.title: Governance, local development and justice
items.body: Turning decentralization into action, strengthening local institutions and expanding access to justice.

items.title: Stabilization and social cohesion
items.body: Building on progress in stabilization while strengthening resilience, social cohesion and support for refugees and host communities.

items.title: Climate, energy and inclusive growth
items.body: Accelerating climate action, advancing clean energy and creating more inclusive economic opportunities, with women at the centre of solutions.

items.title: Youth and innovation
items.body: Creating opportunities for young people to build digital skills, drive innovation and shape Chad's future.

closing.body: This is what lasting transformation looks like: working alongside the Government, local governments, development partners, civil society and the private sector. Together. So that women, men and communities can shape their own future.
